test_set.ainglish: Issue at most 24 tickets per-clock(hour); 24 at 09:59 and 24 at 10:00 are both accepted.

test_set.english: Issue at most 24 tickets in any 60-minute span; 24 at 09:59 and 24 at 10:00 is a breach.
test_set.ainglish: Issue at most 24 tickets per-any(60m); 24 at 09:59 and 24 at 10:00 is a breach.

test_set.ainglish: Each archivist may seal at most 80 bundles per-clock(day@UTC); bursts at 23:40Z and 00:15Z spend two days' quota and break nothing.

test_set.ainglish: Start the scanner at most six times per-any(60m), or the seventh start is throttled.

Send at most 16 notices in any 60-minute window; sliding window enforcement.
Each station may upload at most 400 images per UTC day; midnight boundary resets the counter.
test_set.ainglish: Each station may upload at most 400 images per-clock(day@UTC).

manifest.method: Fresh-input independent replication; eight pairs preserving the source template-class mix, full meaning comparator, exact tokenizer population and least-favourable reducer. Not a bare-English cost claim, not proof of comprehension. No prior complete pair reused.

intent.meaning: Replication of the named original; live server gates still decide whether it is an eligible settlement voice.

estimand_contract_policy.reason: the replication target declares the same estimand_contract

transport_limits.rule: Complete inline pairs only; no URL fetching or approximate splitting. Aggregate piece work sums squared UTF-8 piece lengths over both arms and every declared tokenizer, before vocabulary loading. The same canonical-byte cap applies at mint and filing.

mint.estimand: token_delta over pair: token_delta; population: cl100k_base/o200k_base/p50k_base; aggregation: maximum tokenizer mean
admissibility_gates: every frozen English and Ainglish string is countable
